name: UNIDOC-BENCH
description: UNIDOC-BENCH is a large-scale, realistic benchmark for document-centric multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (MM-RAG). It includes 1,600 multimodal QA pairs derived from 70k real-world PDF pages across 8 domains, supporting evaluation across text-only, image-only, multimodal fusion, and joint retrieval paradigms.
reputation: A new large-scale document-centric MM-RAG benchmark; promising but not yet established as a widely used standard.
notes: Includes 20% QA pairs validated by multiple annotators and expert adjudication; supports apples-to-apples comparison across four MM-RAG paradigms.
